messages:
erin: Heads up — main CI is failing consistently on integration matrix. Root cause looks like the s3-mock used by blobstore tests is crashing with EMFILE. Re-ran twice, same failures across different runners.

ashish: saw this too on #2234, thought it was my change at first. Failing log snippet: 
```
Error: EMFILE, too many open files
    at Object.openSync (fs.js:480:3)
    at module.exports (/opt/app/mock-s3/index.js:72:10)
    at startServer (/opt/app/mock-s3/server.js:21:5)
```

infra-bot: CI job 8472 failed: integration/large-matrix (runner: linux-x86-2). Auto-rerun attempted and failed (2/3).

maya: @erin @ashish any recent changes to the s3-mock Dockerfile or the test harness that could bump fd usage? I can check image diffs.

erin: @maya there was a change in the test image last week that increased parallel workers in the mock: https://git.internal/r/test-images/commit/7f2b9de — it sets MAX_WORKERS=16 by default (was 6). Might be related.

trevor: If it's EMFILE that's usually ulimit or too many concurrent connections from parallel tests. Two quick checks: 1) confirm ulimit in the image, 2) see if a PR increased parallelism.

ashish: I pulled the image locally and hit same. ulimit -n shows 1024, code opens a file descriptor per request and never closes in one path. But the repro rate jumps when MAX_WORKERS=16.

rachel: Can we revert MAX_WORKERS to 6 in the test image and re-run CI? If that stabilizes we can dig into fd leak.

erin: I'm going to queue a revert job for the test-image repo now. @ci-bot please trigger integration/large-matrix after revert lands.

ci-bot: Triggered job 8473 for integration/large-matrix (post-revert). Waiting for runner.

infra-bot: NOTE: several runners reported high fd usage but no host-level throttling. Suggested mitigation: reduce test harness parallelism or increase ulimit for mock container.

maya: Also proposing a short-term patch in mock-s3 to add a periodic cleanup for stale fd handles (small fix) and an issue to audit close paths.

ashish: I'd be happy to open the patch PR if revert proves green. Meanwhile bisect request: anyone object to running a quick git bisect across test-image change range? Could find exactly which commit toggled the behavior.

trevor: Go for it. If you run bisect, run with MAX_WORKERS set to 8 as intermediate to see threshold. I can monitor runners during bisect.

erin: Revert landed at 2026501285, CI job 8473 started. If green we mark revert as hotfix and follow up with a proper fix.

ci-bot: Job 8473 completed: PASS ✅ (integration/large-matrix).

erin: Good — reverting MAX_WORKERS looks like the right immediate step. Filing follow-up: https://git.internal/r/issues/INFRA-512 — include bisect + fd leak PR.

maya: I'll add a runner-side guardian to bump ulimit for mock containers in the short term so other flakes don't hit.

ashish: Opening PR for mock-s3 fd cleanup now: #328. Will include a small test to stress open/close.

rachel: Thanks team. @everyone if you see similar flaky failures, ping this thread and tag infra. We'll coordinate bisect/patch. :thumbsup:

erin: closing loop — marking incident as triaged. Will keep follow-ups in INFRA-512.
